title: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle
description: Mario joins forces with Rabbid heroes in a colorful turn-based strategy adventure packed with movement skills, overwatch tactics, weapon synergies and humorous exploration. Travel across the Mushroom Kingdom, build a team of three, use pipes and dashes to reposition, and defeat enemy waves and bosses through smart tactical play.

gameplayPillars.title: Tactical movement
gameplayPillars.description: Use team jumps, dashes, pipes, high cover and low cover to build strong turn-by-turn positioning advantages.

gameplayPillars.title: Hero synergy
gameplayPillars.description: Combine Mario, Luigi, Peach and the Rabbid heroes to create complementary attacks, buffs and battlefield control.

gameplayPillars.title: Exploration and puzzles
gameplayPillars.description: Outside battles you explore connected zones, collect secrets, solve simple puzzles and unlock new weapons and paths.

gameplayPillars.title: Tactical positioning and cover
gameplayPillars.description: Battles revolve around movement ranges, flanking lanes, and smart use of full or partial cover. Good positioning often matters as much as raw damage output.

gameplayPillars.title: Kingdom exploration and secrets
gameplayPillars.description: Between fights, each kingdom includes light exploration, environmental puzzles, hidden chests, and collectible content that expands the adventure beyond combat.

worldSummary: A dimensional accident fuses the Mushroom Kingdom with the chaotic Rabbids world. Mario and his unusual new allies journey across warped regions filled with puzzles, enemy encounters and comic set pieces to restore order.

storyChapters.title: Worlds collide
storyChapters.body: A strange machine merges the Rabbids and the Mushroom Kingdom, creating chaos across familiar Mario locations.

storyChapters.title: Build the team
storyChapters.body: Mario gathers Rabbid allies and unlocks new hero combinations, weapons and special skills as the journey expands.

storyChapters.title: Defeat the corruption
storyChapters.body: Late-game battles demand smart positioning, weapon synergy and careful management of cooldowns and status effects.

storyChapters.title: Clean up the Megabug disaster
storyChapters.body: Mario, Luigi, Peach, and Rabbid allies travel across the Mushroom Kingdom after a chaotic invention fuses Rabbids, technology, and familiar locations.

storyChapters.title: Donkey Kong Adventure and extra battles
storyChapters.body: Post-launch content adds a separate Donkey Kong-focused campaign with its own maps, enemy types, and tactical twists for players who want more combat scenarios.

features: Deep turn-based tactics with approachable controls
Distinct hero abilities, weapons, and team synergies
Donkey Kong Adventure DLC expands the campaign with a separate storyline

faq.q: What kind of game is it?
faq.a: It is a turn-based tactics game with exploration, character upgrades and puzzle-like positioning.
The main campaign is single-player, while select challenge and co-op modes support local two-player play.
Yes. The early game introduces core mechanics gradually, while later difficulty comes from deeper tactical combinations.

faq.q: Is Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle beginner-friendly?
faq.a: Yes. It starts gently, explains movement and cover clearly, and remains approachable while still offering tougher optional challenges later on.

faq.q: Does the game include extra content?
faq.a: Yes. The best-known expansion is Donkey Kong Adventure, which adds a separate side campaign with new heroes, new areas, and additional tactical encounters.

verdictSummary: Overall score: 8.7/10. Strengths include Excellent tactical readability; Charming crossover presentation; Strong mix of accessibility and depth. Main drawbacks include 30 fps presentation; Exploration can feel light.
verdictPros: Strong mix of accessibility and depth
Smart map design keeps battles varied
Exploration adds charm between combat arenas
verdictCons: Some difficulty spikes can surprise casual players
Exploration segments are lighter than the tactical combat itself

reviews.quote: Widely praised for its tactical design and crossover concept.
